events.title: Taiwan Open of Surfing 2026
events.description:
Experience Taiwan’s east-coast surfing culture around Jinzun in Taitung. The long coastline and northeast monsoon create the wave conditions that make the Donghe and Jinzun area a prominent destination for surfing events.

The official tourism calendar lists the event from November 6 to November 22. The marker indicates the Jinzun Harbor event area. Consult the organizer’s latest announcements for competition sessions and any weather-related changes.
events.address: 臺東縣 東河鄉 金樽漁港

events.title: Taipei New Year’s Eve Countdown 2027
events.description:
Welcome the new year at Taipei City Hall Civic Plaza. The city’s large outdoor celebration brings together well-known performers and live entertainment for a shared countdown.

The festivities coincide with the Taipei 101 New Year show. The marker indicates Civic Plaza rather than every viewing location. Check the official event notice for the final performance schedule, transport arrangements and crowd controls.
events.address: 臺北市 信義區 臺北市市民廣場

events.title: Pingtung Luoshanfeng Art Festival 2026–2027
events.description:
Discover an outdoor art season shaped by the strong seasonal winds of southern Taiwan. Large installations and performances bring the coastline around Haikou Harbor in Checheng into the exhibition.

The festival uses the harbor, nearby beach and seaside art venue to connect contemporary art with the landscape and local character. The map marks the principal site; individual installations and programs may be spread across the area.
events.venue: Haikou Harbor and the seaside art venue
events.address: 屏東縣 車城鄉 海口港看海美術館

events.title: Xinshe Sea of Flowers & Taichung International Flower Carpet Festival 2026
events.description:
Explore large-scale flower carpets and floral art in Xinshe, a rural district in the hills of Taichung. The festival connects seasonal flowers with local farming, community projects and regional tourism.

The outdoor displays celebrate central Taiwan’s horticulture and agricultural products. The map marks the main exhibition area; use the official information for access and the latest visitor arrangements.
events.address: 臺中市 新社區 行政院農業部種苗改良繁殖場第二苗圃

events.title: Sun Moon Lake Fireworks Music Carnival 2026
events.description:
Enjoy a seasonal series of music performances and fireworks around Sun Moon Lake. The program brings live music to different lakeside venues, with fireworks scheduled in connection with selected performances.

This listing covers the full carnival season, ending on November 14. Events do not take place every day and the venues vary by session. The map marks the lake’s main visitor area; check the official program for the specific concert location and fireworks timing before traveling.

events.title: Maolin Purple Butterfly Season 2026–2027
events.description:
Explore the winter migration of purple crow butterflies in Maolin. The seasonal program provides interpretation to help visitors understand the butterflies’ overwintering ecology and the conservation of their habitat.

Selected dates also feature family activities, conservation markets and cultural performances connected with local Rukai communities. The season runs through March, but workshops and market sessions have their own dates and registration requirements. The map marks the Maolin visitor area; refer to the official program for each activity.
events.venue: Maolin Visitor Center and Purple Butterfly Ecological Park
events.address: 高雄市 茂林區 茂林遊客中心
